During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a champion of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans, [[Jicoln Cadera]] owned and wielded a '''''beskad'''''. The [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Sword/Legends|sword]] was decorated with the [[Skeleton/Legends|skulls]] of felled warriors, and bore a [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] adorned with the skull of a ferocious [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]], symbolizing the hunger for war and destruction prized by Mandalorians of the era.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jicoln Cadera's ''beskad'' first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December]] [[2011]].
